_comment: Settings for edge/vision.py, owned by the model team. N and K: a cat must be seen in the trap zone in K of the last N frames. thresholds: minimum confidence per class. Zones are normalized (0..1) polygons, x left to right, y top to bottom. Status: thresholds are starting values and zones are PLACEHOLDERS. Later: Phase 2a set thresholds from training/eval.py's threshold sweep; Phase 2b redraw both zones from a frame of the mounted camera, with the hardware team.
